description: PLUed Memorization Learning Sequence — all codes verified against IFPS registry, with size/region/variety splits
design_notes: Items with size-based PLU variants are taught as SIZE SETS — all sizes presented together on one card.
Items with variety/form splits (bunch vs crowns, field vs greenhouse) are taught as VARIANT SETS.
Items with regional splits (East/Central vs West) include case-count context so learners understand the overlap.
Fuzzy logic should flag when a learner enters a valid code for the item but wrong size/region/form.
Frequency rankings based on IFPA 2025 household penetration data + ACNielsen/Circana sales data.

item_types.single: One PLU code covers all sizes. Just learn the number.
item_types.size_set: Multiple PLU codes for different sizes of the same item. Learn the set.
item_types.variant_set: Multiple PLU codes for different forms (bunch vs crowns, field vs greenhouse). Learn the set.
item_types.region_size_set: PLU codes split by both size AND growing region. Learn the full matrix.

waves.label: Core 12
waves.description: Highest-frequency produce by US household penetration (IFPA 2025)

items.name: Banana
items.card_note: 4011 is the common banana code; 4186 is small. Do not assume every banana uses 4011.

items.name: Russet Potato
items.card_note: No size split. Other potato types: Red=4073, White=4083, Yellow=4727.

items.name: Yellow Onion
items.card_note: Two sizes! Large (4093) is in the veggie block. Small (4665) is way up in the 46xx range near mushrooms.

most_common.reason: Large yellow onions outsell small at most stores

items.name: Roma Tomato
items.card_note: No size split. Official name is Plum/Italian/Saladette/Roma. NOT 3151 (that's Vine Ripe Large).

items.name: Gala Apple

codes.size_spec: 100 count and smaller, avg fruit weight < 205g
88 count and larger, avg fruit weight 205g+

items.card_note: West uses odd codes: 4133 small, 4135 large. East/Central uses even codes: 4132 small, 4134 large.

most_common.reason: Large Gala is the most stocked size

items.name: Carrots (Loose)
items.card_note: No size split. Bunch carrots = 4094, Baby = 4560, Sticks = 4563. Loose (4562) is the most common bulk code.

items.name: Iceberg Lettuce
items.card_note: No size split. Romaine=4640, Green Leaf=4076, Boston/Butter=4632.

items.name: Red Seedless Grapes
items.card_note: No size split. Green seedless=4022, Black seedless=4056. Red Globe (seeded)=4636.

items.name: Green Bell Pepper (Field Grown)
items.card_note: 4065 is the everyday field-grown large green pepper; 4681 is field-grown small. Greenhouse small=3119, large=3120.

most_common.reason: Field grown large green pepper is the standard grocery item

items.name: Cucumber
items.card_note: No size split. English/Long Seedless=4593. Hot House=4593.

items.name: Celery
items.card_note: 4070 (small) is the common one. Nice round number in the veggie block. Large (4583) is in the 45xx zone. Hearts=4575, Sticks=4576.

most_common.reason: Small bunch (4070) is what most stores stock as their standard celery

items.name: Hass Avocado
items.card_note: Three sizes! 4046 is the most common (small/med). Don't learn just one. All three show up at retail. Green-skin varieties have different codes entirely (4222, 4771).

most_common.reason: Small/medium Hass is the highest volume avocado SKU in the US

waves.label: Citrus Trio
waves.description: Lemon (with size splits), regular lime, and Key Lime

items.name: Lemon
items.card_note: Three sizes. 4053 (large) is the most commonly seen. No regional split like oranges.

most_common.reason: Large lemons are the standard grocery size

items.name: Lime
items.card_note: Two varieties. Regular (4048) is the common grocery lime. Key Lime (4305) is smaller, rounder, more aromatic, used in Key Lime pie. Neither has a size split.

most_common.reason: Regular Persian lime is 95%+ of lime sales

waves.label: Broccoli & Navel Orange
waves.description: Broccoli has form variants; navel has the most complex size/region matrix in produce

items.name: Broccoli
items.card_note: Crowns (3082) are most common at retail. The whole head is 4060 in the veggie block. Florettes (4548) for pre-cut. Don't confuse with cauliflower florettes (4566).

most_common.reason: Crowns outsell whole bunch broccoli at most retailers

items.name: Navel Orange
items.card_note: ⚠️ FIVE codes! Split by region AND size. Higher case count = smaller fruit. East/Central 'Large' (100ct) is actually SMALLER than West 'Medium' (88ct). West codes are most common since CA produces most US navels.

most_common.reason: Large West navel (56ct) is the most common; CA produces most US navels

waves.label: Mushroom & Corn
waves.description: Common checkout items — mushrooms have size/variety splits

items.name: White Button Mushroom
items.card_note: Small (4645) is in the 46xx mushroom zone. Large (4085) is in the veggie block! Cremini/Brown=4648, Portabella=4650. These are technically the same species at different growth stages.

most_common.reason: Large button mushrooms (8oz/16oz packs) are the standard retail size

items.name: Sweet Corn (Yellow)
items.card_note: No size split. White corn=4077. Yellow (4078) is far more common.

waves.label: Pepper Colors & Second Apple
waves.description: Red bell pepper has field/greenhouse split; Fuji apple has size split

items.name: Red Bell Pepper
items.card_note: Field grown (4088) is in the veggie block right after Roma tomato (4087). Greenhouse (4688) is in the 46xx zone. Your store may use one or the other, check what's stocked.

most_common.reason: Varies by store — field grown (4088) is traditional, greenhouse (4688) growing. Check your store's source.

items.name: Fuji Apple

codes.size_spec: 100 count and smaller, avg fruit weight < 205g
88 count and larger, avg fruit weight 205g+

items.card_note: Small=4129, Large=4131. Compare to Gala (4133/4135), Fuji codes are 4 less than Gala for each size.

most_common.reason: Large Fuji is the most stocked size

waves.label: Tomato & Grape Depth
waves.description: Second tomato variety and green grapes

items.name: Vine Ripe Tomato
items.card_note: Vine Ripe has a size split! 3151 is the large, this is NOT Roma (Roma=4087). On-the-vine/truss tomato (picked still on vine) = 4664, which is a different thing.

most_common.reason: Large vine ripe is the standard tomato size

items.name: Green Seedless Grapes
items.card_note: No size split. Red seedless (4023) minus 1 = green seedless (4022).

waves.label: Squash & Spinach
waves.description: Popular cooking vegetables — both are single codes

items.name: Zucchini
items.card_note: No size split. Yellow zucchini/gold bar=4086. Regular zucchini (4067) is in the veggie block between green pepper (4065) and green onion (4068).

items.name: Spinach
items.card_note: No size split. 4090 is in the veggie block near onion (4093).

waves.label: Melon Duo
waves.description: Watermelon is a variant set (seeded vs seedless); cantaloupe has size split

items.name: Watermelon
items.card_note: Seeded=4031, Seedless=4032. Seedless is far more common today. Mini seedless=3421. Yellow seeded=4340, yellow seedless=4341.

most_common.reason: Seedless has almost entirely replaced seeded watermelon at retail

items.name: Cantaloupe
items.card_note: Two sizes. 4050 (large) is more common. Don't confuse 4032 with cantaloupe. That's seedless watermelon!

most_common.reason: Large cantaloupe is the standard grocery size

waves.label: More Apples
waves.description: Granny Smith and Honeycrisp round out the apple family

items.name: Granny Smith Apple

codes.size_spec: 100 count and smaller, avg fruit weight < 205g
88 count and larger, avg fruit weight 205g+

items.card_note: ⚠️ Unlike Gala/Fuji where small and large are 2 apart, Granny Smith codes are wildly separated: 4139 vs 4017. Large (4017) is near banana (4011) and orange (4012)!

most_common.reason: Large Granny Smith is the most stocked size

items.name: Honeycrisp Apple
items.card_note: Honeycrisp has a size split: 3283 large, 3468 small. Both live in the 3xxx range.

waves.label: Garlic, Cilantro & Cauliflower
waves.description: Small high-frequency items + cauliflower with its size/form splits

items.name: Garlic
items.card_note: No size split. 4608 is in the 46xx zone with mushrooms and shallots (4662).

items.name: Cauliflower
items.card_note: 4079 is the small/standard cauliflower code; 4572 is large. Florettes=4566; Green=4567; Purple=4568.

most_common.reason: Small/standard whole head is the most common; florettes growing in popularity

items.name: Cilantro
items.card_note: No size split. Cilantro=4889, Dill=4891, Mint=4896. Italian parsley=4901 and curly parsley=4899.

waves.label: Yellow Pepper & Vine Tomato
waves.description: Building on pepper and tomato families already learned

items.name: Yellow Bell Pepper
items.card_note: Field (4680) vs Greenhouse (4689). Compare: Green field=4065, Red field=4088, Yellow field=4680. No clean pattern between colors!

most_common.reason: Most yellow bells at grocery are greenhouse grown (4689), but check your store

items.name: On-the-Vine Tomato (Truss)
items.card_note: This is tomatoes sold still attached to the vine/truss. Different from Vine RIPE (3151/4805) which is about ripening method. 4664 is near yellow onion small (4665).

waves.label: More Lettuce & Green Onion
waves.description: Romaine and green leaf are the next most common lettuces after iceberg; green onion is an everyday item

items.name: Romaine Lettuce
items.card_note: No size split. 4640 is in the 46xx zone, NOT in the veggie block with iceberg (4061). Romaine hearts are often sold bagged with a UPC, not a PLU.

items.name: Green Leaf Lettuce
items.card_note: 4076 sits between red leaf lettuce 4075 and white corn 4077. Sweet potato is 4074.

items.name: Green Onion / Scallion
items.card_note: No size split. 4068 is in the veggie block between zucchini (4067) and green cabbage (4069). Different from shallots (4662) and leeks (4629).

waves.label: Pear Trio
waves.description: Three most common pear varieties — all have size splits; Bosc also has a regional split

items.name: Bartlett Pear
items.card_note: Small (4024) is in the fruit row near grapes. Large (4409) is in the pear zone (4409-4423). Red Bartlett=4410.

most_common.reason: Large Bartlett is the standard grocery size

items.name: D'Anjou Pear
items.card_note: Small (4025) is in the fruit row. Large (4416) is in the pear zone. Red D'Anjou=4417.

most_common.reason: Large D'Anjou is the standard grocery size

items.name: Bosc Pear
items.card_note: Bosc is the most complex pear, 4 codes split by size AND region, similar to navel orange. 4026 (West) is in the fruit row. 4411-4413 are in the pear zone.

most_common.reason: Large West Bosc is most common — majority of US pears come from WA/OR

waves.label: Hot Peppers
waves.description: Jalapeño, serrano, poblano, and habanero — the four most common hot peppers

items.name: Jalapeño Pepper
items.card_note: Green (4693) is far more common. Red (4694) is just a ripe green jalapeño. Both in the hot pepper zone (4690s).

most_common.reason: Green jalapeño is 90%+ of jalapeño sales

items.name: Serrano Pepper
items.card_note: No size split. 4709 is in the 47xx hot pepper zone. Smaller and hotter than jalapeño.

items.name: Poblano Pepper
items.card_note: No size split. 4705. The dried version is called Ancho. Mild heat, large size, often stuffed.

items.name: Habanero Pepper
items.card_note: 3125. The only common hot pepper in the 3xxx range. Very hot. Don't confuse with scotch bonnet (similar look, different code).

waves.label: Pineapple & Mango
waves.description: Tropical fruits — pineapple has size split, mango has color/size splits

items.name: Pineapple
items.card_note: Small (4029) is in the fruit row. Large (4430) is in the 44xx zone. Most stores carry large, 4430 is the more common code.

most_common.reason: Large pineapple is what most stores carry

items.name: Mango (Red)
items.card_note: Mango PLUs are organized by SKIN COLOR, not variety. Red covers Tommy Atkins, Kent, Haden, etc. Yellow/Ataulfo mango is a separate code: 4312 (small), 4961 (large). Green/Keitt=4311.

most_common.reason: Small red mango (Tommy Atkins etc.) is the most common size at retail

waves.label: Kiwi & Asparagus
waves.description: Both are single codes, commonly purchased

items.name: Kiwifruit
items.card_note: No size split. 4030 is in the fruit row. Gold kiwi=4301.

items.name: Asparagus (Green)
items.card_note: Standard (4080) is the common one. Right at the edge of the veggie block after cauliflower (4079). Large (4521) is less common. White asparagus=4522, Purple=3079.

most_common.reason: Standard green asparagus is the everyday item; jumbo is specialty

waves.label: Potato & Sweet Potato Variants
waves.description: Red potato, white onion, and the sweet potato family

items.name: Red Potato
items.card_note: No size split. 4073 is right next to russet (4072) in the veggie block. White=4083, Yellow/Yukon=4727.

items.name: Sweet Potato / Yam
items.card_note: Complex family. The orange-fleshed sweet potato most people buy is 4074 (small) or 4817 (large). Golden (4816) and White (4091) are different varieties. 4091 is in the veggie block; 4074 is too.

most_common.reason: Small orange-fleshed sweet potato is the most common grocery sweet potato

items.name: White Onion
items.card_note: White onion=4663. Compare yellow large=4093, yellow small=4665, and red=4082.

waves.label: Stone Fruits
waves.description: Peaches, nectarines, and plums — seasonal but high volume. All have size splits.

items.name: Yellow Peach
items.card_note: 4037 is small yellow peach; 4038 is large. 4044 is tree-ripened/ready-to-eat, not the regular large code.

most_common.reason: Large/ready-to-eat yellow peach is the standard retail size

items.name: Yellow Nectarine
items.card_note: 4035 (small) and 4036 (large), consecutive numbers in the fruit row. White nectarine (tree-ripened)=3035.

most_common.reason: Large yellow nectarine is the standard retail size

items.name: Plum
items.card_note: Black (4040) and Red (4042), both in the fruit row. Pluots/Plumcots have their own codes (3278, etc.).

most_common.reason: Black plum is more widely stocked than red plum

waves.label: Herbs
waves.description: Parsley (two types), basil, dill, and mint — the most common fresh herbs after cilantro

items.name: Italian Parsley
items.card_note: 4901. Looks very similar to cilantro (4889), one of the most common produce mix-ups. Curly parsley=4899.

items.name: Curly Parsley
items.card_note: 4899. Two apart from Italian (4901). Curly is more commonly used as garnish.

items.name: Fresh Basil
items.card_note: 4885. Opal basil=4886, Sweet basil=4887. Herbs are clustered 4885-4908: Basil(4885), Chives(4888), Cilantro(4889), Dill(4891), Mint(4896), Parsley curly(4899), Parsley Italian(4901), Rosemary(4903), Thyme(4907).

items.name: Fresh Dill
items.card_note: 4891. Pickling dill=4893 (different code). Regular dill is used fresh; pickling dill includes the flower head.

items.name: Fresh Mint
items.card_note: 4896. In the herb cluster between lemon grass (4894) and oregano (4897).

waves.label: Cabbage & Squash Varieties
waves.description: Green cabbage plus butternut and acorn squash

items.name: Green Cabbage
items.card_note: No size split. 4069 is in the veggie block between green onion (4068) and celery (4070). Red cabbage=4554, Napa=4552.

items.name: Butternut Squash
items.card_note: No size split. 4759 is in the squash zone (4750-4770). Acorn=4750, Spaghetti=4776.

items.name: Acorn Squash
items.card_note: No size split. 4750 starts the squash zone. Spaghetti squash=4776.

waves.label: Specialty Mushrooms & Ginger
waves.description: Cremini, portabella, and ginger round out Tier 2

items.name: Cremini / Brown Mushroom
items.card_note: No size split. 4648 is in mushroom row (4645-4652). Cremini are actually baby portabellas, same species (Agaricus bisporus) as white button and portabella, just different growth stages.

items.name: Portabella Mushroom
items.card_note: No size split. 4650. Same species as cremini (4648) and button (4645/4085), just fully mature.

items.name: Ginger Root
items.card_note: No size split. 4612. Often sold by weight. In the 46xx zone near garlic (4608) and collard greens (4614).

waves.label: More Apples: Red & Golden Delicious
waves.description: Classic apple varieties — both have size AND regional splits like navel orange

items.name: Red Delicious Apple

most_common.reason: Large West Red Delicious is the standard grocery size

items.card_note: 5 codes! Regional + size split like navel orange. West codes (4015/4016) are in the fruit row near Granny Smith large (4017). East codes (4167/4168) are in the apple zone.

items.name: Golden Delicious Apple

most_common.reason: Large Golden Delicious is the standard grocery size

items.card_note: The reversal is West-only: 4020 large, 4021 small. East/Central is normal: 4136 small, 4137 large. Extra large=3285.

waves.label: Pink Lady & Braeburn
waves.description: Two more popular apple varieties

items.name: Pink Lady / Cripps Pink Apple

most_common.reason: Large Pink Lady is the standard grocery size

items.card_note: Small=4128, Large=4130. Right before Fuji (4129/4131) in Apple Alley. Pink Lady is a trademarked name for Cripps Pink variety.

items.name: Braeburn Apple

most_common.reason: Large Braeburn is the standard grocery size

items.card_note: Small=4101, Large=4103. In the 41xx apple zone. Two apart like Fuji and Gala.

waves.label: Grapefruit & Cherry Tomato
waves.description: Grapefruit has a size split; cherry tomatoes are increasingly popular

items.name: Ruby/Red Grapefruit

most_common.reason: Small/standard grapefruit is more common than jumbo

items.card_note: 4027 is the common small Ruby Red grapefruit code; 4047 is the small alternate. Large=4281.

items.name: Cherry Tomato (Red)
items.card_note: No size split. 4796. Yellow cherry=4797. Most cherry/grape tomatoes are sold in clamshells with UPCs, but loose ones need the PLU.

items.name: Grape Tomato
items.card_note: 4799 is actually the greenhouse/hydroponic regular tomato (large). True grape tomatoes are often sold under retailer-assigned codes or UPC clamshells. Check your store's system.

waves.label: Eggplant, Green Beans & Radish
waves.description: Three common veggie-block-adjacent items

items.name: Eggplant
items.card_note: 4081 is regular purple eggplant. Chinese=3089, Thai=3090, Japanese=4601.

items.name: Green Beans
items.card_note: No size split. 4066 is in the veggie block between green bell pepper (4065) and zucchini (4067).

items.name: Red Radish (bunched)
items.card_note: No size split. 4089 is in the veggie block right after red bell pepper field (4088). Daikon radish=4598.

waves.label: Beets, Leeks & Shallots
waves.description: Less common but regular items at most stores

items.name: Beets (Red)
items.card_note: No size split. 4539. Golden beets=4540. In the 45xx root vegetable zone.

items.name: Leek
items.card_note: No size split. 4629. Baby leek=4630. Not the same as green onion (4068), leeks are much larger.

items.name: Shallots
items.card_note: No size split. 4662 is in the 46xx onion zone near white onion (4663) and vine tomato (4664).

waves.label: Winter Squash
waves.description: Spaghetti squash and delicata — seasonal but popular

items.name: Spaghetti Squash
items.card_note: No size split. 4776 is in the squash zone (4750-4789). Popular low-carb pasta substitute.

items.name: Yellow Crookneck Squash
items.card_note: No size split. 4784. The common 'yellow squash' at grocery. Straightneck yellow=4782. Different from yellow zucchini (4086).

items.name: Yellow Straightneck Squash
items.card_note: 4782. Some stores use this interchangeably with crookneck (4784). The shape of the neck is the difference.

waves.label: Tropical Fruits
waves.description: Papaya, coconut, and Ataulfo/yellow mango

items.name: Papaya
items.card_note: 4394 is regular large papaya. 4052 is the standard small Solo/Hawaiian papaya code. Cooking/Mexican papaya=4395.

items.name: Coconut
items.card_note: No size split. 4260. Young/green coconut and coconut water are usually sold with UPCs.

items.name: Ataulfo / Yellow Mango

most_common.reason: Small Ataulfo is the standard size — they're naturally smaller than red mangos

items.card_note: Mangos are coded by SKIN COLOR: Red=4051/4959 (wave 14), Yellow/Ataulfo=4312/4961, Green/Keitt=4311. Ataulfo is flatter, creamier, and less fibrous than red varieties.

waves.label: Cherries, Tangerines & Apricots
waves.description: Fruits sold loose that actually need PLU entry — not clamshell/scan items

items.name: Red Cherries
items.card_note: 4045 is the common all-sizes red/black cherry code. Size-specific codes also exist: 3357 small, 3358 large.

items.name: Tangerine / Mandarin
items.card_note: 4055 covers loose tangerines/mandarins. Cuties, Halos, etc. in bags have UPCs, but loose ones at the bin need this PLU. Right after raspberries (4054) in the fruit row.

items.name: Apricots
items.card_note: 4218=small/standard apricot; 3302=large. Red apricot is 3614.

waves.label: Onion & Pepper Variants
waves.description: Red onion, orange bell pepper, and Anaheim chile

items.name: Red Onion
items.card_note: No size split. 4082 is in the veggie block. Unlike yellow onion which has small (4665) and large (4093), red onion is one code for all sizes.

items.name: Orange Bell Pepper

most_common.reason: Most orange bells at retail are greenhouse grown

items.card_note: Field (4682) vs Greenhouse (3121). Orange greenhouse is in the 3xxx range. The only common greenhouse pepper there. Compare: Red greenhouse=4688, Yellow greenhouse=4689.

items.name: Anaheim / New Mexico Chile
items.card_note: 4677. Long, mild green chile. New Mexico chile=4700. Common in Southwestern cooking.

waves.label: Specialty Items
waves.description: Jicama, plantain, tomatillo — items that round out a well-stocked produce department

items.name: Tomatillo
items.card_note: 4801. Looks like a small green tomato in a papery husk. Essential for salsa verde. NOT a green tomato.

items.name: Plantain
items.card_note: 4235. Looks like a large banana but must be cooked. NOT banana (4011). Common in Latin, Caribbean, and African cooking.

items.name: Jicama
items.card_note: 4596 is pickling cucumber/Kirby: short, firm, and crisp, suited for pickling.

items.name: Honeydew Melon

most_common.reason: Large honeydew is the standard grocery size

items.card_note: Small (4329) and Large (4034). Gold honeydew=3100. Large honeydew (4034) is in the fruit row near lemons and kiwi.

organic_rule.description: Prefix any 4-digit PLU with 9 to get the organic version
organic_rule.card_note: Once you know conventional codes, organic is free, just add 9 in front. Works for ALL sizes: 94046 = organic small Hass, 94225 = organic large Hass.

number_neighborhoods.label: Apple Alley
number_neighborhoods.pattern_note: Fuji 29/31, Gala 33/35, Granny 39. All odd numbers! Small is always 2 less than large (except Granny large=4017, the rebel).

confusing_pairs.warning: 3151 is Vine Ripe Tomato (large), NOT Roma. Roma = 4087.
4664 is On-the-Vine (truss) tomato. 3151 is Vine RIPE (large). Different ripening method vs selling format.
4032 is Seedless Watermelon, NOT cantaloupe. Cantaloupe large = 4050.
Both are red bell pepper. 4088 = field grown. 4688 = greenhouse. Check your store.
Both are broccoli. 4060 = bunch. 3082 = crowns. Crowns are more common at retail.
Both are cauliflower. 4079 = whole small head. 4566 = florettes (pre-cut).
Both are white button mushroom. 4085 = large (40mm+). 4645 = small (< 40mm).
East/Central 'large' navel (4385, 100ct) is physically smaller than West 'medium' (3107, 88ct). Case count is inverse to fruit size.
Both are Granny Smith. 4017 = large (in the fruit row!). 4139 = small (in Apple Alley). Unlike Gala/Fuji, these are far apart.
